```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(psych)
water_data <- read_csv("Data/water_potability.csv")
water_data <- water_data |>
  mutate(Potability = factor(Potability,
                             levels = c(0, 1),
                             labels = c("Not Potable", "Potable")))

water_data
```

```{r}
str(water_data)
```

```{r}
describe(water_data)
```


```{r}
colSums(is.na(water_data))
```

```{r}
water_data_trimmed <- water_data |>
  drop_na()

describe(water_data_trimmed)
```
